## Purpose
The background runs package. Long creation pipelines (workflow plans, agents, tool and activity synthesis) are owned by the process instead of the HTTP connection, so navigating away no longer cancels them half-way. Only an explicit cancel stops a run.

## Responsibilities
A docstring that maps the modules: manager, store and runners.

## Nuances and gotchas
Before runs existed, navigating away aborted the fetch and the server cancelled the pipeline, sometimes after it had already created agents.
